title: Omnilingual-MsASR: Benchmarking Multimodal, Multilingual, Long-Form Multi-Speaker ASR of Omni Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.29455v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Omni-modal large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in audio and video understanding. However, existing models struggle with long-form, multi-speaker videos, especially in understanding the entire video and recognizing who says what and when. To characterize the capability limit of current omni LLMs and guide future model development, we introduce Omnilingual-MsASR, a multilingual, multimodal benchmark for long-form Multi-speaker Automatic Speech Recognition (MsASR) covering six languages, recordings up to 30 minutes, and scenarios with up to 20 speakers. Omnilingual-MsASR provides parallel audio and video inputs to evaluate models' cross-modal consistency and their ability to exploit complementary cues across modalities. Extensive evaluations of leading omni-modal LLMs reveal substantial performance bottlenecks, while their tcpWERs frequently exceed 100%. These findings highlight fine-grained temporal localization,

translated_title: Omnilingual-MsASR：面向全模态大语言模型的多模态、多语言、长时多说话人语音识别基准测试
translated_abstract: 全模态大语言模型（Omni LLM）在音频和视频理解方面取得了显著进展。然而，现有模型在处理长时、多说话人视频时表现不佳，尤其是在理解整个视频以及识别“谁在什么时间说了什么”方面。为了刻画当前全模态大语言模型的能力极限并指导未来的模型开发，我们提出了Omnilingual-MsASR，这是一个面向长时多说话人自动语音识别的多语言、多模态基准测试，涵盖六种语言、长达30分钟的录音以及最多包含20个说话人的场景。Omnilingual-MsASR提供并行的音频和视频输入，以评估模型的跨模态一致性以及利用跨模态互补线索的能力。对领先的全模态大语言模型进行的广泛评估揭示了显著的性能瓶颈，其tcpWER经常超过100%。这些发现凸显了细粒度时间定位（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了Omnilingual-MsASR，一个涵盖六种语言、最长30分钟、最多20个说话人的多语言多模态长时多说话人语音识别基准，揭示出当前全模态大语言模型在该任务上存在严重性能瓶颈，tcpWER经常超过100%。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Omnilingual-MsASR, a multilingual, multimodal benchmark for long-form multi-speaker ASR covering six languages, up to 30-minute recordings, and up to 20 speakers, which reveals substantial performance bottlenecks in leading omni-modal LLMs whose tcpWERs frequently exceed 100%.
